item.stem:
Feroz looks at the diagram. Straight lines $\ell$ and $m$ lie on the same flat page and meet at point $P$.

Which claim correctly names the lines and the angle structure at $P$?

options.A: Lines $\ell$ and $m$ are intersecting, and their meeting at $P$ forms four angles.
options.B: Lines $\ell$ and $m$ can meet at two different points on the page if they are drawn longer.
options.C: The four angles at $P$ are what force lines $\ell$ and $m$ to meet.
options.D: Call $\ell$ and $m$ parallel, because they lie on the same flat page.
